name: Brass Eight
explanation: An eight-voice, sixteen-oscillator polyphonic analog synthesizer modelled control-for-control on the Oberheim OB-Xa (OB-Xa Owner's Manual, 3rd Ed., April 1982, read cover to cover). Each of the eight voices is a complete synth with two VCOs, two selectable low-pass filters (a 2-pole and a 4-pole), two ADSR envelopes and a VCA. OSC 1 has an octave FREQUENCY control (4-octave range) and independent SAW and PULSE waveform switches that sum additively. OSC 2 has a coarse FREQUENCY (5-octave, half-step), a bipolar DETUNE (+/-50 cents, flat or sharp of OSC 1), and its own SAW/PULSE switches; SYNC hard-locks OSC 2 to OSC 1 for the classic timbral sweep, and F-ENV routes the Filter Envelope to OSC 2's pitch (amount set by the filter MODULATION control, up to +1 octave). A shared PULSE WIDTH control sets both oscillators' duty (50% square fully CCW, thin/nasal CW). The programmable MODULATION section is a LFO (SINE / SQUARE / SAMPLE&HOLD, ~0.1-20 Hz) with a FREQUENCY DEPTH routable to OSC 1 / OSC 2 / FILTER and a PULSE-WIDTH DEPTH routable to OSC 1 / OSC 2. The FILTER section both selects the sound sources into the filter (OSC 1, OSC 2 at HALF or FULL level, pink NOISE) and shapes them: FREQUENCY, RESONANCE (raises level in 2-pole, lowers it in 4-pole), MODULATION (filter-env amount), a 2-POLE/4-POLE slope switch (the OB-Xa signature: 12 dB/oct bright vs 24 dB/oct full) and keyboard TRACK. Two four-stage ADSR envelopes drive the Filter and the Loudness (VCA). Performance: polyphonic PORTAMENTO with linear/quantized and offset options, UNISON (low-note-priority 8-voice stack), HOLD latch, a PITCH BEND lever (OSC-2-only and NARROW +/-whole-step vs +/-octave switches), a MOD lever that fades LFO vibrato in, master TRANSPOSE (+/-octave), MASTER TUNE and VOLUME. Switch groups are bit-packed into single host parameters; the panel decodes and shows every individual switch. SPLIT / DOUBLE dual-keyboard modes, chord-memory transposition, auto-tune and the cassette/patch-memory system are host or hardware concerns and are out of scope (single Whole-mode patch).
